hero.name: Géza Fodor
hero.lead: I have more than 25 years of experience in IT and software development. I began my career as a print graphic designer, went on to develop web applications and portals, and spent most of the past two decades programming navigation systems.
facts.experience: years of experience in IT and development
about.title: Where design meets development
about.p1: My professional background includes script-based development for navigation systems, web application and portal development, and the preparation of print and multimedia content.
about.p2: Throughout my career, I have worked in both graphic design and software development roles. This allows me to give equal weight to visual design and functionality when creating digital solutions. I am currently expanding my skills in React and TypeScript.
about.p3: My work reflects precision, effective communication, strong teamwork, and independent problem-solving.
